title: Dinner and Flamenco
text: A great evening of food and entertainment at Zoraya restaurant.  Getting there is simple enough by taxi or by walking with google maps depending on your location and level of fitness. The roads leading up to the restaurant narrowed to a single lane for both vehicles and pedestrians. On arrival, the staff were very friendly and welcoming. The menu consisted of a very decent local fare of 3 courses with choices, drinks not included, but cava and sherry were offered with dessert. title: Delicious authentic and...
text: Delicious authentic and illusion cuisine that our whole family enjoyed. We love the flamenco experience. The musician, singer, and two dancers were outstanding. We made some great memories. Thank you for a great experience.
author: Jennifer_M

title: Very nice evening
text: There is a fantastic 3-course menu, very delicious and sufficient. To conclude, a sherry. Very nice staff. You have to like flamenco. It is simply a matter of taste.
author: Sabine_R

title: Fabulous
text: Pouring down rain only made dinner on the covered terrace more beautiful. Food was excellent and the Flamenco was fabulous.
author: Lynnette_B

title: Amazing, Intimate Flamenco at its Best!
text: What an amazing, intimate flamenco show! We were seated directly in front of the stage and loved every minute of the energetic show, from the singing and guitar music to the wonderful flamenco. They allow photos and video (without flash) during the entire show. The tapas dinner beforehand was yummy and provided plenty of food. Between dinner and the show, we had time to walk over to the San Nicolás Viewpoint (a 5-10 min walk), which overlooks the Alhambra, for a breathtaking nighttime view of the entire complex. title: Take a taxi
text: Excellent dinner and show BUT the Albaicín neighborhood is traffic restricted to taxis and other public transportation due to narrow streets. Do your selva a Hug favor and take a cab
author: B529FBjamesd

title: Great evening for all ages
text: Fantastic evening. Lovely terrace setting. The restaurateurs were all very friendly and professional. Food was excellent large portions very nicely presented. Flamenco dancing and singing was very entertaining.
author: Denise_M

title: Entirely Amazing
text:
Best Experience, Best Service. 
Flamenco was just an amazing show, Breath Taking Performances.

author: Sultan_F

text: Excellent service from the start. All four of us enjoyed the meal before the show - the grilled Iberian pork loin especially was superb and you have to try the home made lemonade, a good range of meals on the 'Menu Sabores De Andalucia' for cater for most tastes. The grilled Corvina fish was delicious. The French Toast with mango sorbet did not last long on the plate. The Flamenco show was very good with a mix of traditional songs with a fantastic and soulful singer and a brilliant guitarist (I also play, but he was a lot better than me!) and superb dancers. Everyone enjoyed it.
author: Wanderer00359318471

title: Flamenco in Granada has been amazing.
text: The whole event was amazing from start to finish. The female dancer blew us away and the male dancer was equally awesome. And the meal before was superb.
author: Martin_R
